text:
taylor: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about the reliability incident. Posting RCA link + condensed action list so we can assign and close.

taylor: RCA: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-912 (root cause: stale routing preferences + unexpected failover path). timeline + artifacts in doc.

jim: thanks. are we planning a soft rollout first or full immediately?

taylor: soft canaries started; plan is soft for 48h then full rollout if no regressions.

maya: i'll own the soft-rollout checklist and verification steps. will include latency, error-rate, and cache-hit checks.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: route-pref-canary-1 -> success; route-pref-canary-2 -> success.

frank: i'll open a small PR to add defensive guards in the route-applier. ETA: 48hrs.

zoe: comms: what phrasing for status page? prefer conservative wording until full rollout.
taylor: suggested blurb: "Mitigation deployed; validation ongoing; full rollout scheduled pending confirmation."

maya: accepted: soft-rollout checklist + verification -> maya (due 2026-04-07).

frank: accepted: defensive PR -> frank (due 2026-04-06).

mica: accepted: follow-up perf checks (embeddings & generation tail) -> mica (due 2026-04-07).

jim: small ask  can we add this regression test to the onboarding checklist for new model deployments? seems related.

taylor: yes, add it to model-onboarding and notify devex.

ops-bot: audit-log: permission-grant-request for cross-region dashboards -> approved.

taylor: ACTION SUMMARY (also mirrored to tracker):
- maya: soft-rollout checklist & verification (due 2026-04-07)
- frank: defensive route-applier PR + unit tests (due 2026-04-06)
- mica: perf verification for embeddings & gen tails (due 2026-04-07)
- jim: add regression test to model-onboarding checklist (due 2026-04-08)
- zoe: draft status page blurb; publish after full rollout (pending)

taylor: please react when you've started your item so I can mark progress on the tracker. ping here for blockers.

frank: quick question  should the guard be hard-fail on rollout or soft-flag for 1 week?
maya: soft-flag 1 week, then enforce; collect telemetry.

zoe: will wait for maya signoff before posting to status.

maya: starting verification now; will update in the tracker when 24h, 48h marks complete.

taylor: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in the ops sync if anything unexpected pops up. :white_check_mark:
